dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: Hey, remember when we played Cattin with Bobby last Friday?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Hey, remember when we played Cattin with Bobby last Friday?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo
dialogue_lines.text: Yeah. He built the longest road and then wouldn't trade me a single sheep. Total tyrant.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Yeah. He built the longest road and then wouldn't trade me a single sheep. Total tyrant.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: Don't you get a feeling... when you watch him play like that?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Don't you get a feeling... when you watch him play like that?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo
dialogue_lines.text: Wha... what? What do you mean, a feeling? Like, indigestion?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Wha... what? What do you mean, a feeling? Like, indigestion?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: The way he moves the pieces... the way he builds. That long... long road of his. And the way he whispers, ore for wheat.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: The way he moves the pieces... the way he builds. That long... long road of his. And the way he whispers, ore for wheat.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo
dialogue_lines.text: I... guess? He does have really good settlement placement?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I... guess? He does have really good settlement placement?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: And when he rolled a seven and moved the robber? I had to leave the room.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: And when he rolled a seven and moved the robber? I had to leave the room.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo
dialogue_lines.text: Dude. We were playing at your house.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Dude. We were playing at your house.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: So... you also find him sexy when he plays Cattin?
